notes: File RSR_IK.txt in Maxar_Spectral_Response_2023.zip, distributed by the reseller Apollo Mapping (not hosted by Maxar). SVO's archived records cite the same page. SVO's archived IKONOS/OSA records have wavelengths 10 times too large (pivots ~10x); this curve agrees with them to 0.12 % after that factor. The file's 'CTR WL' for NIR (794.37 nm) is 2.3 % above the energy pivot. No instrument paper reference verified. DetectorType energy assumed.
